meta.title: Buddha Fortune Sticks - S-Jiffy
meta.description: The Buddha Fortune Sticks consist of 51 sticks. Worship the Buddha and draw a stick to ask about warding off calamity, resolving misfortune, career and wealth; sincerity is what matters.
desc: The Buddha Fortune Sticks consist of 51 sticks. Worship the Buddha and draw a stick to ask about warding off calamity, resolving misfortune, career and wealth; sincerity is what matters.
ui.1: Silently recite your name and your request, keep a kind heart, then draw a stick.
ui.2: This tool's data comes from public traditional culture materials and is for entertainment reference only.
